{{Top|leg}}
"'''Summertime'''" was a song.

==History==
By the time of the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the origins of "Summertime" had been forgotten and it had come to be considered an ancient classic. The [[Space Monkeys]] performed the song in about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while in the [[Space Monkey Café]], a bar that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
